profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies
profile.summary:
Currently working for Qualcomm as a camera engineer in Automotive. In Qualcomm, I'm responsible for developing a camera sensor driver, serializer, and deserializer and verifying/customizing a specific use-case via the ISP pipeline. And Worked for Vinsmart in Vietnam as a camera expert and worked for LG Electronics in the US, San Diego, and Korea for the last 15 years as a camera engineer and BSP engineer. And I'm responsible for Camera SW and am a System engineer that verifies new features and technology and makes a product such as LG G and V series in mobile cameras. 

- Ability to develop/verify a camera sensor (QNX/Linux) and a pipeline plugging in the driver in the camera framework
- Ability to develop/verify a serializer and deserializer driver with multiple camera sensors via GSML 
- Ability to develop/verify MIPI CSI driver (dphy/cphy) and understand/verify the register set of camera ISP to meet a feature request
- Ability to configure an ISP pipeline with multiple streams according to the use case. E.g., MIPI Raw, ISP processed image, Meta, Crop, etc.
- Ability to understand hardware configuration well and to develop appropriate ISP pipeline configuration and driver
- Ability to implement Hand-on development of a BSP and Camera component driver with C/C++ language

Specialties : 

- Integration of Software for camera ISP
- Customization of a new feature of a camera for a product with a new chipset
- Creating a camera architecture on a new chipset to make a new feature and technology
- Camera system engineering 
- Partnership management 
- Product management

positions.title: Professional Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead the development smartphone camera at LG San Diego lab. Design the HW/SW camera architecture for new camera technology such as EIS, HDR10, ToF, multi and high resolution cameras system. 

- I have been working with a mainly Qualcomm for a camera and vision processing team for the last 5 years and verified a many features on a new chipset. For example legacy features on SDM845 and SM8150 / SM8250.  HDR10 and HDR10+ decoding and encoding and so on.

- I have experience to verify AR (Tango) project with Google. And Lead the project with a many  AP company and companion chip maker (Qualcomm, Intel, Altek, Movidius, Socionext, etc) and IR sensor company (PMD)

- Quality tuning with Qualcomm for HDR10 decoding and encoding on G6 and G7

- Interest point : Advanced features in camera such as multi and high resolution camera (depth, seamless zoom, QBC etc) and a multi frame HDR,SR,NR and a strong EIS and so on.

- Developed LGE premium camera feature such as V10 and 20 (Steady Cam2.0 and 3.0 (EIS)), G6(Dual camera), G7 SDM845 camera features with HDR10. 

- Developed device partnership with Qualcomm through the technical discussion about new camera concept and technology or critical issue such as power consumption and image quality and stability 

- Special experience : Overseas representative for LG Mobile engineering at San Diego

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Roles & Responsibilities:

•	Software Engineering for W-CDMA software development.
•	W-CDMA protocol layer development.
        - Development and verification Layer 1 Stack in W-CDMA 
        - Development and verification Searcher algorithm for multi-channel in W-CDMA modem protocol.
        - Development and verification a power management between a handset and a base station in W-CDMA
        - Development and verification Rx diversity for RF.

•	Participation in Agency for Defense Development project at Taiwan.

SKILLS:

•	Low level Device driver Programming.
•	Kernel Programming
•	Android service Programming. For example Display, Sensors and etc..
•	C language Programming
•	Wireless Communication System in W-CDMA.
